key.name: close-all-gesture
key.summary: Swipe right at the start of the app switcher to close all apps
key.description: With the app switcher at its first app, drag from left to right past the threshold and release. A drag that starts further along the list only scrolls. The Clear all button is always there.

key.name: close-all-keep-ready
key.description: On: apps kept ready or started at login (Settings > App Launch) stay open when closing all, like pinned apps on Android. Off: close all closes them too. The dialer is never closed during a call.
